correctness.rationale: PASS: Finite-dimensional Ito identity verified. Wick constant killed by gradient exactly since (e.grad)c_N=0 and Pi_N kills k=0 mode. Trilinear pairing <v,Pi_N(e.grad)(v^2/2)>=<v,(e.grad)(v^2/2)> vanishes by divergence theorem on T^2; DRAFT writes 1/6 vs correct 1/3 for (e.grad)(v^3) factor but zero remains exact. Poincare gap gamma=(2pi)^{5/2}~98.96 correctly computed as (4pi^2)^{5/4}. Gronwall sup_N sup_t E||u_N||^2<=K(1+||u0||^2), K=max(1,tau/2gamma) holds (loose but valid); time-integrated bound (5) has factor-2 looseness (V0/T vs V0/2T) still uniform. H^{5/4} moment plus H^{5/4} compact into C^{-kappa} via s-d/2=1/4>-kappa gives Krylov-Bogoliubov tightness uniformly in N,T>=1. Global Galerkin existence follows a posteriori from energy bound preventing explosion. Numerical replay (cancellation 2.5e-17, gamma/K checks, 20-trial energy 0.17 vs bound 1.25) consistent; numerics not part of proof. Lemma gives boundedness+tightness only, no invariant-measure limit, uniqueness or gap, honestly limited.

originality.rationale: FAIL: Headline is textbook Galerkin energy ledger mechanically implied by standard skew-symmetric SPDE theory, not new. Exact cancellation <v,partial_x(v^2/2)>=0 is undergraduate integration-by-parts underlying all Burgers/Navier-Stokes energy estimates (Da Prato-Debussche-Temam 1994 stochastic Burgers; E-Khanin-Mazel-Sinai 2000 1D Burgers invariant measures; Goldys-Maslowski 2005 1D Burgers/2D Navier-Stokes ergodicity; Brzezniak-Debbi-Goldys 2011 FSBE Lemmas 3-4 prove harder 1D white-noise L2 bounds with interpolation). With trace-class noise and any coercive A the Ito bound d/dt E||u||^2<=-2gamma E||u||^2+tau and Krylov-Bogoliubov tightness via compact Sobolev-Besov embedding are routine exercises; sigma=5/2, e=(1,0), K=max(1,tau/2gamma) are mere parameter substitutions. Wick ordering is vacuous here since gradient kills constant, so no renormalization content. No source needs to state sigma=5/2 verbatim: broader textbook theorem substantively implies it.
